notes.v1_10: Dead Tree: Paint the trunk as smooth warm brown bark with only a few broad, soft grooves that follow the twist, in place of the dense grain lines. Make the lawn a slightly softer, less acid green, and make the cast shadow short, soft and attached at the roots. Keep the purple stripes and the curled branches.
notes.v1_07: Magic Mirror: Make the green backdrop one even mid green to the corners, with a quiet tone-on-tone stripe pattern and no dark corners or floor glow. Show the glass as a soft pale reflection with one gentle sheen, in place of the diagonal white streaks. Make the gold frame slightly satin, with one soft highlight band; keep the scrolls and the base.
notes.v1_08: Haunted House: Remove the moon. Paint the walls a warm cream-tan stone with a few faint block lines, and the roof slate-blue in broad soft rows with no per-tile highlights. Let the window light glow only just around each window, with no yellow pool on the grass; keep the tower, the chimney and the night sky.
notes.v1_09: Night Gate: Replace the cobblestones with a few large, smooth paving slabs in a light mauve. Make the pillars a warm sandstone with soft shading in place of the dark outlines and cracks, and lift the sky slightly to a medium dusk blue. Remove the moon, the chain and the padlock; keep the iron gate and the hedges.
notes.v1_01: Pumpkin: Make the purple backdrop one even mid violet to the corners, with a quiet tone-on-tone ray pattern and no glow behind the pumpkin. Add a plain purple floor plane under it with a crisp dark plum contact shadow. Shade the right side and the rib grooves slightly darker in burnt orange; keep the glowing face and the stem.
notes.v1_05: Candelabra: Make the striped wall a brighter mid purple and the table a lighter warm wood with smooth satin faint grain, with no orange light pools on it. Paint the candelabra a soft satin silver with cool blue-grey shadows, lit softly from the upper left. Keep the small candle flames, the candles and the stripes.
notes.v1_06: Crystal Ball: Make the table a lighter warm orange wood with smooth, faint grain and a soft short shadow, in place of the dark noisy wood. Give the ball one small soft round highlight in place of the hard window shape, and soften the smoke into gentle teal wisps. Keep the gold stand and the pink swirl.

notes.v2_07: Key: Paint the key as smooth warm aged bronze with copper-orange and brown tones, in place of the gritty pitted grey iron. Give it one or two clean highlight bands along the top of the ring and shaft, and a slightly darker lower-right side. Add a soft, faint shadow below and to the right; keep the green sunburst and the diagonal pose.
notes.v2_08: Grandfather Clock: Draw the clock slightly larger so it fills most of the card height. Make the green backdrop one even tone out to the corners, with no bright pool of light on the floor. Make the floor shadow short and soft; keep the wood case, the face and the gold pendulum.
notes.v2_04: Rocking Chair: Draw the stone ledge as smooth, warm grey blocks with soft edges and no speckle or pitting. Give the cat soft blue-violet highlights on its head, shoulders and haunch from the upper left. Calm the pink glow behind the cat slightly; keep the eyes, the ears and the purple stripes.
notes.v2_03: Binoculars: Make the grass a smooth, slightly deeper green lawn with soft broad shading and only a few blade hints, with no clovers. Add a soft, defined shadow on the grass beside the broom. Group the bristles into a few broad bundles; keep the red binding and the wooden handle.
notes.v2_05: Candy Bowl: Make the table clean, warm, honey-coloured wood planks with faint quiet grain, with no chipped paint, scratches or nail heads. Give the glass a slightly brighter rim highlight; keep the candies and the blue ring backdrop.
notes.v2_10: Motel: Replace the small cobbles with a few large, soft warm grey-tan paving stones that fade out away from the lamp. Paint the post a deep green metal with a brass trim. Let the lantern's warm light spill slightly down the post and onto the nearby stones; keep the lantern and the dusk sky.
notes.v2_01: Fountain: Make the table clean, warm wood planks with faint quiet grain, with no chipped paint, scratches or nail heads. Make the pumpkin skin smooth and glossy with no scratchy streaks; keep the glowing face, the stem and the blue stripes.
notes.v2_09: Cobweb Window: Let the candle cast a slightly warm glow onto the inner frame and the sill. Make the glass a deep blue with one soft reflection, in place of flat black. Keep the stone wall, the cobweb and the night sky.

notes.v3_08: Make the table clean, warm, honey-coloured wood planks with faint quiet grain, with no nail heads, worn grey streaks or scuffs. Make the cast shadow slightly shorter and softer. Keep the pumpkin pail, the candies and the cyan rings.
notes.v3_06: Paint the spider a deep purple-blue with one broad soft violet sheen from the upper left, in place of black. Make the stone slab smooth, warm sandy stone with soft edges and no cracks or moss. Keep the yellow spots, the eyes and the cyan ring backdrop.
notes.v3_05: Paint the wood as smooth warm orange with one broad soft highlight on the left and only faint grain. Lift the darker top corners so the green backdrop is slightly more even, and make the shadow slightly shorter and softer. Keep the glass, the sand and the pose.
notes.v3_01: Make the sky a bright daytime blue with soft clouds, in place of the night sky, moon and stars. Light the pumpkin from the upper left with a slightly darker right side, and keep only a soft warm glow inside the carved face. Keep the blue door, the ivy and the step.
notes.v3_02: Paint the hat a deep purple felt with violet-blue shadows and one soft sheen on the left of the cone, in place of grey-black. Make the table lighter, warm honey wood with faint grain, and keep the green stripes evenly bright out to the corners. Keep the orange band, the gold buckle and the hat shape.
notes.v3_10: Make the sky a bright soft daytime blue with a few small clouds, in place of the purple dusk. Replace the gazebo with more of the green hedge. Paint the trunk as smooth warm brown bark with a few broad soft twists, lit on the left; keep the tree's shape and the lawn.
notes.v3_07: Replace the dark planks with light, warm honey-coloured wood in broad soft stripes with shallow plank gaps. Make the purple cover slightly softer plum with lighter lilac edges. Keep the gold star, the clasp and the diagonal pose.
notes.v3_09: Make the sky strip a bright daytime blue, in place of the night sky, moon and stars. Paint the wall warm sandy stone with soft faint mortar lines and soft blue-violet shadows, in place of crisp grey bricks. Keep the arched door, the arch stones, the brass ring and the step.
